name: Four Segments
justification: Sort four numbers and multiply two of them; satisfying mini-observation, instant verdicts.
solution_sketch: Pair the two horizontal and two vertical segments; each side of the rectangle is the min of its pair. With a sorted (b0<=b1<=b2<=b3), pairing (b0,b1) and (b2,b3) is optimal, giving area b0*b2.
